description:
src/methods/metadata.rs — of the 5 async builder methods, only metadata_set (lines 185-196) has a # Errors rustdoc section. The other four return Result<_, jmap_base_client::ClientError> but lack a # Errors section:

  - metadata_get          (lines 44-50  doc-comment, line 51 fn)    → no # Errors
  - metadata_changes      (lines 81-93  doc-comment, line 94 fn)    → no # Errors
  - metadata_query        (lines 233-281 doc-comment, line 282 fn)  → no # Errors
  - metadata_query_changes (lines 314-322 doc-comment, line 323 fn) → no # Errors

This matters for two concrete reasons:

1) Undocumented client-side validation paths. metadata_changes (line 104-108) and metadata_query_changes (line 330-334) include defence-in-depth empty-state checks that return Err(ClientError::InvalidArgument) with a method-specific message. A caller reading the doc-comment has no way to discover this. They would reasonably assume an empty &State round-trips to the server and produces some server-side error (e.g. cannotCalculateChanges); instead they get a client-side InvalidArgument with a specific string. The error path is silently invisible from the rustdoc.

2) Rustdoc convention + clippy::missing_errors_doc. The standard rustdoc convention is that public fn returning Result documents each variant in a # Errors section. clippy::missing_errors_doc is a common downstream lint (workspace Cargo.toml does not currently enable it, but downstream consumers may). The pre-existing # Errors section on metadata_set demonstrates the in-crate style; the asymmetry across the 5 methods is a consistency gap.

Concrete error variants each method should document:
  - All five: ClientError::InvalidSession when self.session has no primary account for "urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata" (via session_parts at mod.rs:248-258)
  - All five: ClientError::HttpError / ParseError / ApiError from call_internal → upstream JmapClient::call
  - metadata_changes: additionally ClientError::InvalidArgument when since_state is empty (line 104)
  - metadata_query_changes: additionally ClientError::InvalidArgument when since_query_state is empty (line 330)
  - metadata_set: already documented for the update map serialize failure path (line 185-196). Should be extended to mention InvalidSession + transport errors too.

Fix: add # Errors sections to all 5 builder methods, matching the existing metadata_set style. metadata_changes / metadata_query_changes need explicit mention of the empty-state InvalidArgument case.

Workspace-wide: same gap likely exists on canonical mail-client. Propagate from canonical.

Cross-ref: wzq9.11 (decision note approving the defence-in-depth guards), wzq9.16 (ClientError::InvalidArgument is string-typed and undispatchable — orthogonal but related).
title: Missing # Errors rustdoc sections on metadata_get / metadata_changes / metadata_query / metadata_query_changes
